AN INDEPENDENT PLATFORM

One platform.
Game-specific care.

Ultimatum is building a consistent home for classic games: clear setup, thoughtful controls, durable saves, and honest information about what each game needs.

Ultima IV is the first supported game. Future games will share the platform around them without being flattened into the same interface or losing what makes them distinct.

WHY ULTIMATUM

Made for the game—and for you.

Designed for each device
Mobile is treated as its own composition, not a smaller desktop.
Local first
Play and keep portable backups without creating an account.
Built to preserve
The engine keeps authority over the game while imports and saves are validated and protected.

READY TO PLAY?

Bring your own Britannia.

Ultima IV requires your own copy of the original game data. Launch the game and we’ll verify it and guide you through setup.

Your game and saves stay local by default. Optional accounts add private save synchronization and recovery history; signing in never uploads original game data automatically.
